Name: Improved Airframes
Description: Fighters defend at +1 first round per battle.

Name: Air Transport Doctrine
Description: Tactical Bombers gain transport: they may airlift 1 infantry unit and drop it in friendly territory (movement rules apply).

Name: Zeppelin development
Description: You now can produce Airships A0/D0/M5/C8 (counts as a bomber), which can perform Tactical Bombing and are ignored by target’s AAA.

Name: Defensive Turrets
Description: When participating in a bombing raid (strategic or tactical) bombers may fire defensively during interception.

Name: Improved scramble (ATC)
Description: Scramble may now be performed by 6 eligible units in total.
Remarks: Possibility of allied forces maybe as an extra technology

Name: Bombing Calibration
Description: During a Strategic Bombing Raid the first hit caused by defensive AAA is ignored.

Name: Strategic Airship Movement
Description: Airships can now perform Strategic Bombing and are be ignored by target’s AAA.

Name: Air Research Centre
Description: One time bonus: during deployment phase player may add one air unit  for free.
Path: NUCLEAR, SBOMBER, TBOMBER, AIRSHIP, INFANTRY, FIGHTER

Name: Long-Range Aircraft
Description: All air units gain +1 movement.

Name: Advanced Fighter Development
Description:
Fighters participating in an Escort or Interception now hit on a 1 or 2 instead of just a 1.
Optional OIL: if fighters are present in battle first battle costs no oil.

Name: Paratroopers
Description: Tactical Bombers gain transport: up to two infantry can be picked up and dropped off in friendly or hostile territory. If dropped in hostile territory the Infantry will join combat.
Remarks: Tactical bombers joining combat after dropping infantry is another technology

Name: Carpet Bombing
Description: Bombers gain Bombing Troops: Bombers can bomb armies in enemy territories just as facilities, every hit removes one troop from the territory (or does one damage if a unit has multiple damage points). If the army under attack has AAA-units, they may defend.

Name: Jet Engine Theory
Description: Fighters attack at +1.

Name: Engine Optimization
Description: Tactical bombers may perform two actions  in same turn if movement allows.

Name: Heavy Bomber Design
Description: You can now produce Flying Fortresses: A5/D2/M8/C15, which can perform Strategic Bombing, while ignoring first interceptor hit.
Remarks: Red is extra technology: When attacking, whether in a battle or a strategic bombing raid, roll two dice for each bomber and select the best result.

Name: Heavy Strategic Bombing Doctrine
Description: Strategic Bombing now hits on a +1.

Name: Early Jet Fighters
Description: Fighters defend at +1.

Name: Under the cover of the night
Description: During Strategic Bombing roll two dice per participating bomber in stead of 1.
Remarks: For balancing purposes: Add 3 in stead of 2 to the results of your Strategic Bombing rolls.

Name: Under the Radar
Description: Tactical bombing raids now rolls with two dice per participating bomber.

Name: Flying Fortress Capability
Description: Flying Fortress can now has Atomic Delivery.

Name: Basic Research Facility
Description: One time bonus: get one free Research Token.
Flavour_text: No inherent bonus — structural gate only.

Name: University
Description: You are now able to build a university, which grants 1 Research Token per turn.

Name: Oil Derrick
Description: You are now able to build an Oil Derrick for 6 IPC. Can only be placed in an oil producing territory (marked on map and Resource Territory, see sheet). The amount of Oil produced per turn depends on the territory.

Name: Early Radar
Description: AAA (both from facilities and units) hit on 1–2 instead of 1.

Name: Heavy Water Chemistry
Description: You are now able to build Heavy Water Facility, which produces 1 Heavy Water Resource per turn.

Name: Improved AA Procedures
Description: Each AAA may fire at +1 additional target.

Name: Basic Drilling
Description: Oil Derricks cost -1.

Name: Improved Refining
Description: NEEDS Abitilty
Flavour_text: Flexible boost, great for all nations

Name: Integrated Air Defense Network
Description: AAA may reroll first miss per battle.

Name: Reactor Theory
Description: You are now able to build a Nuclear Power Plant, which produces +1 IPC per turn.

Name: Radar Wave Theory
Description: Fighters intercept at +1.

Name: Synthetic Fuel Production
Description: You are now able to build a Synthetic Oil Plant, which converts 3 IPC → 1 Oil.
Remarks: Possible balancing rule: max 3 Oil per turn.

Name: Offshore Extraction
Description: Oil Platforms produce 1 additional Oil per turn on top of the amount of Oil the Seazone indicates.

Name: Energy & Physics Institute
Description: One time bonus: upon building this facility choose and receive: 1 Steel, 1 Aluminium, 3 IPC or [optional 1 Oil].
Path: NUCLEAR, FIGHTER, TANK, RAIL, SUBS, BATTLESHIP, ROCKET
Remarks: Enables Research for Rockets and Atomic Bomb.

Name: Advanced Metallurgy
Description: You are now able to build an Aluminium Factory, which produces 1 Aluminium Resource per turn.
Remarks: Required for Jets, Rockets, Flying Fortress.

Name: Reactor Engineering
Description: Required for Atomic Program & Nuclear Subs. NEEDS Ability.

Name: Rocket Propulsion Theory
Description: You can now build Rocket sites, these are bases with the ability to launch rockets. During the Strategic Bombing Raids step of your Conduct Combat phase each turn, each of your operative rocket sites can make a single rocket attack against an enemy facility within 4 spaces of it. They hits on a 1-3 on a d6 roll. When it hits throw 1 d6 to determine the damage to that facility. Rockets may not be fired over neutral territories.

Name: Synthetic Oil Expansion
Description: Synthetic Oil Plant mow converts 2 IPC → 1 Oil.

Name: Advanced Drilling
Description: Your Oil Derricks now produce +1 Oil per turn on top of the Oil production of the Resource Territory.
Flavour_text: Turns sea control into economic power

Name: Heavy Armor Production
Description: You are now able to build a Steel Factory, which produces 1 Steel Resource per turn.
Remarks: Required for Submarines, Capital ships and Tanks.

Name: Uranium Processing
Description: You are now able to build a Nuclear Reactor. A Nuclear Power Plant in the same territory produces +2 IPC per turn.

Name: Rocket Development Program
Description: Your air bases can now launch rockets.  Rockets have a range of +2.

Name: Strategic Payload Integration
Description: Enables delivery capabilities of Atomic bomb (prereq for Flying fortress, Nuclear Sub, Nukes). NEEDS Ability.

Name: Recycle Station
Description: Remove existing units from board within same space as shipyards or factories in order to obtain X amount of aluminium/steel per unit type.

Name: Advanced Ballistics
Description: Rockets hit on 1–2.

Name: Nuclear Delivery
Description: You are now able to produce Nukes. Nukes are launched from Rocket Sites (or eligible equivalent). Nukes have Atomic Delivery. Nukes are destroyed upon arrival. Nukes cost 15 IPC.

Name: Cruise Missile Doctrine
Description: Nukes have a range of +2 spaces.

Name: Seaplane base
Description: You are now able to build a Seaplane base: an air base and naval base at the same time and has both capabilities. Cost = 20 IPC.

Name: War Bonds Campaign
Description: During your Collect Income phase, roll a d6 and collect that many additional IPCs.
Path: NUCLEAR, CARRIER, FIGHTER, PRODUCTION, BATTLESHIP, INFANTRY, ROCKET

Name: Port Efficiency
Description: New naval units may move 1 sea zone after being placed during mobilization (non-combat only).

Name: Lendlease
Description: You can buy troops for allies during your own P&R phase (units will be your units in command of chosen ally). Units will be placed in eligible mobilization places of the receiving power.

Name: Supply Chain Optimization
Description: Strategic Bombing damage reduced by 1.
Path: NUCLEAR, CARRIER, FIGHTER, RAIL, PRODUCTION, BATTLESHIP, INFANTRY, ROCKET

Name: Fuel Efficiency
Description: Once per turn, ignore oil cost for: 1 land attack OR 1 air mission.
When repairing a damaged facility, you can remove 2 damage markers for the cost of 1 IPC.

Name: Standardized Parts
Description: All newly produced units cost 1 IPC less.
Path: NUCLEAR, CARRIER, FIGHTER, PRODUCTION, BATTLESHIP, INFANTRY, ROCKET

Name: Rail Coordination
Description: You are now able to build Railways: during you mobilization phase you can deploy land units in all rail-connected territories of any Industrial Complex (respecting their max placement rules). One Railway section costs 2 IPC and counts as base.

Name: Increased Factory Production
Description: Major industrial complexes can mobilize +2 units, and minor ones can mobilize +1 units.
Path: NUCLEAR, CARRIER, FIGHTER, PRODUCTION, BATTLESHIP, INFANTRY, ROCKET

Name: Civil Defense Planning
Description: All Stratigic Bombing Raids on your Capital Territory ignore 2 damage.

Name: Fuel Logistics
Description: Naval movement into hostile zones costs:  1 Oil for up to 2 sea zones

Name: Protected Oil Infrastructure
Description: Oil Derricks and Oil Platforms: require 3 bombing hits to disable, 6 max damage, repair cost reduced by 1 IPC.

Name: Oil Platform
Description: You are now able to build Oil Platforms for 7 IPC, which can only be placed in Oil producing Seazones (marked on map and Resource Territories, see sheet). The amount of Oil produced per turn depends on the seazone.

Name: Industrial & Logistics Bureau
Description: One time bonus: During your next mobilization phase you may build one Minor Industrial Complex OR upgrade one to a Major Industrial Complex (if rules allow).
Path: RAIL, NUCLEAR, CARRIER, FIGHTER, PRODUCTION, BATTLESHIP, INFANTRY, ROCKET
Remarks: Enables Research for Econimics and Infrastructure

Name: Strategic Rail Network
Description: Land Units moving in interconnected rail territories get a + 2 move bonus.

Name: Industrial Relocation
Description: NEEDS Ability

Name: Mass Production
Description:
Non-naval unit type costs 1 IPC less.
Optional OIL: Oil derrick/platform cost reduced by 1 IPC
Path: NUCLEAR, CARRIER, FIGHTER, PRODUCTION, BATTLESHIP, INFANTRY, ROCKET

Name: War Economy Planning
Description: May convert 1 captured Industrial Complex to operational next turn (also major Industrial Complexes).

Name: Advanced Fuel Efficiency
Description: Oil costs reduced by 50% (round up) for: Land OR air (choose each turn)

Name: Strategic Fuel Reserves
Description: Oil storage cap = +10. Pay 2 IPC per needed oil: Ignore all oil penalties.

Name: Armoured Trains
Description: Railway sections have AAA.

Name: Industrial Mobilization
Description: Industrial Complexes produce +1 unit.

Name: Improved Shipyards
Description:
Your sea units are now cheaper to build. Your Battleships, Aircraft Carriers and Cruisers -3 IPC, and your Destroyers, Transports and Submarines -1 IPC.
Optional OIL: first naval action costs no oil this turn.

Name: Mobile factories
Description: Minor Industrial Complexes gain move 1 during Movement phase.

Name: Industrial Expansion
Description: Capitol territories now have room for 5 facilities in stead of 4. Normal territories now have room for 1 additional facility (total = [IPC-value + 1] facilities), the maximum amount of facilities stays 3.
Remarks: Establish R&D rule for maximum facilities: Base rule for core: Maximum of facilities in a territory is equal to the number of IPC that territory has, whit a maximum of 3 for normal territories and a maximum of 4 for Capital territories.

Name: Express Railway
Description: Units may move over interconnected railways in friendly territory as if it is one move (also in the pre-combet move).
Flavour_text: Railway may be bought during P&R Phase

Name: Megafactories
Description: You can now build Megafactories, which have no limit on production capacity (when without damage) and produce 1 free unit per turn. Damage Points = 15 max = 30

Name: Advanced Assembly Lines
Description: During your Mobilization Phase you may produce one free fighter each turn.

Name: Germany: Enigma
Description: Germany: While enigma is active and only during your own turn in sea battles you’ll have a Surprise Attack with all participating units, this attack cannot be defended and casualties are removed from the board without firing back.

Name: Basic Espionage
Description: Once per round, peek at one opponent’s IPC total before purchases.

Name: Codebreaking
Description: During battle you can force opponent to reroll one round.

Name: Propaganda Campaign
Description: At the beginning of the turn place influence marker in neutral territory (for 4 IPC or move 1 land unit in this territory during combat movement and dissolve unit), then move alignment from neutral to your side at the end of the turn only if you have the most influence markers (enemy aligned => strict neutral => allied aligned) This will not turn Mongolian Neutrals in Russian army troops.

Name: UK: Alan Turing
Description: Can only be researched if Germany has Enigma: In order to use Enigma before every sea battle Germany starts it throws a d6 to determine if enigma is working by rolling a 1.

Name: Cryptographic Systems
Description: Surprise attack on sea battle, one battle per turn in total. Same as submarine, but for whole fleet and not defendable by destroyers.

Name: Propaganda Effect on Mobilization
Description: Recruite +1 Infantry and an additional infantry for every 10 territories occupied by you during your Mobilization Phase. Placement follows normal production rules.

Name: Camouflage
Description: When defending with Land Units, they may have one surprise attack at the beginning of combat, that attach cannot be defended against.

Name: Intelligence Directorate
Description: One time bonus: you may remove one already researched technology from an opposing power. Removed technology does not break dependencies, but this power has to research the technology again to re-activate it.
Flavour_text: Enables development of various intelligence activities.

Name: Espionage Networks
Description: Sabotage an Industrial Complex: Once per turn roll a d6 and on 1–2 roll a d6 for damage.

Name: Signals Interception
Description: Reduce one enemy’s air movement by 1 once per round. Declare during your own mobilization phase.

Name: Stealth Techniques
Description: Disables Enemy Radar capabilities this round for 1 enemy power at cost of 2 IPC. Declare during your own mobilization phase. Effect ends during your next mobilization phase.

Name: Resistance Coordination
Description: Spawn 1 partisan in occupied original territory (once per turn). Join fight as infantry as soon as territory is attacked.

Name: Counterintelligence
Description: Ignore one successful sabotage attempt.

Name: Scientific Espionage
Description: Once per round you may choose to interrupt and roll a d6: on a 1 cancel the research attempt of an opponent of your choice.

Name: Political Influence Operations
Description: Where applicable reduce Intelligence actions cost by 1 IPC.

Name: Mustering locals
Description: In every non-original territory that you occupy you get 1 infantry during your Mobilization Phase.

Name: Counter sabotage
Description: For 3 IPC and a 1 on a 1D6: Cancel one existing tech of your choice from an enemy without breaking dependency chains OR cancel one tech in research (one assigned Research Token). Play this anytime as long as you can pay the costs.
Flavour_text: We go in. We get what we want. We come out.

Name: Espionage
Description: Steal technology from an enemy for 2  IPC and a 1 on a d6 roll (only tech that you are enabled for). You now can use the tech as if you have researched it yourself, the enemy keeps the tech.

Name: Sabotage
Description: Damage 1 facility for 2 IPC this turn. The total amount of damage is the minimum to disable the facility.

Name: Reduced Bombing effect
Description:
Strategic bombing damage reduced by 50% (round down).
Optional OIL: Oil facilities take no damage on rolls of 1–2.

Name: Morale Systems
Description: Once per turn, one battle may ignore the first land unit casualty taken.

Name: Barbed wire
Description: Infantry movement penalty -1 => can be zero!. Purchase cost per barbed wire is 1 IPC.

Name: Entrenchment Doctrine
Description: Last infantry defending in original territories may absorb 1 extra hit before removal.

Name: Barracks
Description: Produce regular infantry (not specialized units) at the cost of 3 IPC.

Name: Mechanized Logistics
Description: Tanks may blitz through 1 additional territory if unoccupied.

Name: Czech hedgehogs
Description: Tanks movement penalty -1

Name: Improved Training
Description: Infantry roll 1 die per round where one miss may be rerolled if attacking with artillery support.
Flavour_text: Small reliability boost. No raw stat change.

Name: Land mine (field)
Description: You can now produce land mines. C3/A0/D2/M0 defend 2 times @ 2 before first round of battle against Land units but tanks, will be removed when it hits, changes owner in case territory is captured and survives battle. In case of multiple: roll all at once and distribute hits over land mines in any way: 2 hits on a 4 die roll can be appointed to one and the same land mine.

Name: Tank Destroyers
Description: You are now able to produce Tank destroyers. C4/A1/D2/M2. At the start of battle and before the first round of combat very unit will attack @ 3 if any enemy tanks are present. Every hit will be on tanks, they have no possibility to fire back.

Name: Urban Warfare Training
Description: Infantry defend at +1 in Capitol territories.

Name: Field hospital
Description: You are now able to build a Field Hospital, which counts as a base. If during battle your infantry is destroyed, roll a d6: on a 1 the casualty returns to nearest field hospital and “respawn” there (but cannot participate in movement phase). If two Field hospitals are at the same distance: owner chooses.

Name: Land Warfare Research Centre
Description: One time bonus: during your mobilization phase you may place one extra land unit for free.
Remarks: Enables Research for Land Units and Bunkers

Name: Bunkers
Description: You are now able to build Bunkers. A bunker absorbs 1 hit every round in battle as long as at least one infantry unit is present. Can be disabled by 5 damage from (tactical) bombing and destroyed by 10 damage (in stead of having a maximum of damage).

Name: Mechanized Warfare Doctrine
Description: Mechanized Infantry and Infantry may move +1.

Name: Advanced Artillery
Description: Each of your artillery units can now provide greater support on Combined Arms. One artillery unit can support up to 2 infantry units.

Name: Concrete bunkers
Description: Every round attacker must sacrifice one land unit, when attacking territory containing a Bunker.

Name: Enforced bunkers
Description: Bunkers get AAA.

Name: Self-Propelled Artillery
Description: Artillery may Blitz and move +1 (like tanks) and support up to two Infantry.

Name: Improved Artillery
Description: Artillery may support 2 Mechanized infantry as Combined Arms.

Name: Improved Mechanized Infantry
Description: Each of your mechanized infantry units that is paired up with a tank now has an attack value of 2 as Combined Arms.

Name: Marines
Description: Marines on transport “arm” the transport +1 attack and +2 defense for every marine aboard add 1 hitpoint to transport. Attack is same as Infantry + 1.

Name: Breakthrough Doctrine
Description: First round tank hits may not be assigned to tanks.

Name: Nuclear bunkers
Description: When a Bunker is present during the Dropping of the Bomb all infantry present will survive the nuclear apocalypse.

Name: Defensive Fortifications
Description: Place 1 Bunker for free per turn in any territory you occupy.

Name: Artillery Fire Control
Description: Artillery attack at 3 when paired as Combined Arms.

Name: Mobile Mechanized infantry
Description: Each mechanized infantry unit may pull an artillery unit up to 2 spaces during movement (both units must originate from the same territory).

Name: Improved Tanks
Description: All tanks now attack +1.

Name: Commandos
Description: Can be dropped in enemy territories behind enemy lines and occupy territory, need to be dropped by transport planes or tactical bombers capable of dropping paratroopers.

Name: Improved Transport Capacity
Description: Transport may carry two land units of ANY choice.

Name: Extended Range Submarines
Description: Submarines gain +1 movement.

Name: Sea mines
Description: When entering a seazone with sea mines roll a d6, on a 1 resolve a hit anywhere on the fleet entering the seazone.

Name: Secret submarine harbour
Description: You may now build Secret Submarine Harbours in Neutral and enemy territories. To do so pay 10 IPC while at least one of your naval units is present in the seazone during mobilization phase. If territory is or becomes occupied by one of your enemies, they roll one d6 every turn on a 1 remove the base. This base cannot be the target of bombardements.

Name: Jet Propulsion
Description: Cruisers may move +2.

Name: Advanced Submarine Hulls
Description: Submarines defend at +1.

Name: Advanced ASW
Description: Destroyers hit submarines on +1.

Name: Torpedos
Description: Capital ships can defend against Suprise Strikes from submarines, the same way destroyers can.

Name: Gatekeeper systems
Description: Transports and Capital ships now have AAA Guns similar to Industrial Complexes and other facilities.

Name: Sea mines – upgraded
Description: Resolve the 1 hit by having the sea mine owner to choose the casualties.

Name: Naval Research Centre
Description: One time bonus: during the mobilization phase in which you build your Naval Research Centre you may also deploy one naval unit of your choice for free.
Path: NUCLEAR, SUBS, CARRIER, PRODUCTION, BATTLESHIP, BUNKER
Remarks: Enables Research for Sea Units and Naval bases

Name: Submarine Fleet Coordination
Description: Submarines may submerge if there is only one destroyer present.

Name: Surface Fleet doctrine
Description: All surface ships may move +1 (Transport, Destroyer, Cruiser, Carrier, Battleship)
Unit_ID: Transport, Destroyers, Cruisers, Aircraft Carrier, Battleship

Name: Sonar
Description: In sea zones w/ enemy naval bases, submarines loose special abilities like there is a destroyer present.

Name: Armed transports
Description: Transports attack and defend at 1.

Name: Mobile submarines
Description: You can now produce Ballistic Missile Submarines. They are like normal submarines and can submerge after suprise attack.

Name: Silent Running
Description: Nuclear Submarines may ignore first destroyer cancellation per turn.

Name: Super battleships
Description: Battleships can attack with two dice.

Name: Fleet Screening Doctrine
Description: Pairing with cruisers gives +1 attack and defense to Carrier.

Name: Heavy Transport Capacity
Description: Transports may carry up to three land units of which one is infantry.

Name: Nuclear Propulsion Doctrine
Description: Submarines may move +2.

Name: Advanced Submarine Propulsion
Description: Your Ballistic Missile Submarines can now deliver the Atomic Bomb and launch it from an adjacent seazone onto a territory.

Name: Heavy battleship
Description: Battleships can take 3 hits, where 1 hits has no functional impact.

Name: Heavy carriers
Description: Carriers can attack and defend +1.

Name: Germany: Occultism: The Ahnenerbe Institute
Description: You can now build the Ahnenerbe Intstitutue: Research Institute for the Occult, which generates 1 Vril energy token per turn. [Every use of researched items in this program cost an amount of Vril.]

Name: Germany: Occultism: Expedition to Tibet
Description: Occupy India, West India, Sikang OR Szechwan to gain access to Tibet and obtain the ability: for 1 Vril energy token ignore one research dependency OR reduce research cost by 2 IPC.

Name: Germany: Occultism: Thule Society
Description: You now have developed the Hannebeau II Saucer: For 1 Vril token the UFO can move 1 infantry from one place to another (if the territory is enemy occupied, the infantry unit is in combat) OR you may move one enemy aircraft back to it’s place of origin.

Name: Germany: Occultism: Spear of Longinus
Description: Using the Spear of Destiny: for 1 Vril token you may determine the outcome of a die roll yourself.
Remarks: VRIL TOKEN converter missing AND ahnenerbe institute increases it’s VRIL generation by 1 every round.

Name: Fighter Jets
Description: Jet fighters defend at 5 and move +1.

Name: Germany: Atlantik Wall
Description: When there are Bunkers in Normandy, Netherlands, Danmark and Norway those territories cannot be the target of Amphibious Assault, although starting combat from sea is still possible, during which all defending infantry and artillery get one round of firing without the chance of response after which normal battle proceeds.

Name: Germany: Wunderwaffen: LandKreuzer P. 1000 “Ratte”
Description: You are now able to produce Landkreuzers: a super heavy armor, which attacks at 5 A5/D5/M2/C9 and needs 2 hits to get destroyed.

Name: Germany: Occultism: Die Glocke
Description: Once per round/for 1 Vril token you can reset the turn of a power (self, enemy or ally). That turn starts all over.

Name: Japan: Kido Butai Doctrine
Description: Production of one extra naval unit for free every turn. And Aircraft Carriers get AAA.

Name: Project Manhattan – Development
Description: Develop and Test Atomic Bomb: Pick one of your original territories and place two radiation tokens on it. Remove one every consecutive turn, as long as there are tokens, the IPC count is 1 IPC and max unit count is limited to infantry. You may move them during movement phase to neighboring territories. Additional to the Research cost pay 1 uranium resource and 2 heavy water. Nuclear Reactor gains uranium-production capability.

Name: Russia: Deep Battle Doctrine
Description: (Mechanized) Infantry may move +1 and may move after combat if territory cleared.

Name: Rail Super Gun -  Schwerer Gustav
Description: You can now produce the Schwerer Gustav: a rail super gun, which can move exclusively on rail and to all rail connected sections in one move and participate in combat 2 territories away. Stays in combat until all friendly land units are out of combat. Can only be targeted by bombings (like a facility, has AAA) A3/Dx/M1/C13

Name: The Wolfpack: Super Submarines
Description: The attack value of your Nuclear Submarines is now +1.

Name: UK: Global Intelligence Network
Description: Spy spawns in capital (A0/D0/M2/C8) and is able to sabotage facilities, steal or cancel tech (while in enemy capital) or cancel one battle this round from the power it is currently residing (play as interrupt in enemy’s combat phase, while not having performed one of your earlier options this round.

Name: US: Industrial capacity
Description: Get 1 unit for free during your mobilization phase from any Cluster (Air, Land, Navel) you have researched reaching tier 6.

Name: Fighter Jets
Description: Fighters attack at 5 and move +1

Name: Germany: Atlantic Wall Pt. 2
Description: If your coastal territory contains a Bunker the enemy cannot do an Amphibious Assault here. You Infantry and Artillery are allowed one free round of firing before battle begins.

Name: Germany: Wunderwaffen: LandKreuzer P. 1500 “Monster”
Description: Landkreuzers now can absord 2 hits and move +1.

Name: Germany: Occultism: Die Glocke
Description: Once per round you can reset the turn of a power (self, enemy or ally). That turn is cancelled.

Name: Japan: Kido Butai Doctrine
Description: Aircraft Carriers can now absorb 3 hits, where 1 hit has no functional impact, may carry +1 aircraft and can participate in Amphibious Assaults.

Name: Project Manhattan – Production
Description: You are now able to produce the Atomic Bomb. Your Nuclear Reactor is now able to produce Atomic Bombs for 2 Heavy Water and 1 Uranium. You will need a means to drop it.

Name: Russia: Deep Battle Doctrine
Description: Every major Industrial Complex creates one (Mechanized) Infantry during mobilization phase.

Name: Rail Super Gun – Langer Gustav
Description: Your Gustav can now join combat 3 spaces away, hits at +1 and has AAA that hits on +1

Name: The Wolfpack: Suprise Tactics
Description: If the number of submarines in a seazone outnumbers the amount of destroyers, the ability to cancel submarine special features is canceled: submarines can perform Suprise Strike, Submerge and Can’t Be Hit By Air Units.

Name: UK: Global Intelligence Network
Description: If spy is present in enemy territory AND territory is attacked by yourself or an ally 3 infantry spawn to join the fight.

Name: US: Industrial powerhouse
Description: Land Units built in Industrial Complexes may be placed in adjacent territories you own and Aircraft may also be placed in any territory containing an air base or seaplane base you own. Build limit per Industrial Complex +2 AND Land units cost -1 IPC.

Name: Project Manhattan – Dropping The Bomb
Description: This is not an actual Research Item (and will not cost IPC’s), but a placeholder that all dependencies are met in order to deliver and drop the bomb on it’s destination. Dropping the Bomb: Atomic attack on a 1-4 d6 roll permanently destroys  all units and maximizes damage on facilities in territory (one-use weapon) and reduces production value of territory to 1 IPC for the duration of 5 years. Place radiation markers (10) in territory accordingly, remove one every round.
